title: Enterprise intake brief and rapid scope protocol
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Objective: Create a lightweight, repeatable protocol for Sales/CS to batch enterprise feature requests into scoped, actionable briefs that PMs and Eng can estimate within a single review. The protocol must fit into a 30–60 minute first-pass workstream and produce: (1) a one-page intake brief, (2) a 3-point priority score, (3) a quick economic proxy, and (4) clear handoff checklist for engineering and solutions. This ticket codifies the template, scoring rules, tooling pointers, and a lightweight sample conversion of three recent customer asks into the brief format. Scope: non-bug enterprise feature requests only. Out of scope: platform-level architectural changes, regulatory compliance gating (those get escalated to Security/Legal).
acceptance_criteria: Template exists in Confluence and is < 1 page
Scoring rubric defined with explicit thresholds for low/medium/high
3 sample customer requests converted to the brief format with sponsor and econ proxy
Handoff checklist includes required artifacts (PRD link, sample prompt set, desired SLA)
PM and Sales pilot run scheduled and results documented
next_steps: Finalize one-page intake brief template and publish to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/enterprise-intake/rapid-brief
Run 60-minute pilot with Sales (Mar 05) + record session notes
Collect feedback and iterate scoring thresholds by Mar 10
Create GH issue template for generated briefs and wire to PM inbox (label: intake-brief)
Schedule handoff workshop with Eng reliability and solutions on Mar 18

sample_briefs: Brief A - Account: Helix Health. Ask: Private model hosting with HIPAA audit logs. One-line value: Required for contract renewal ($1.2M ARR). Econ proxy: ARR at risk. Score components: Strategic Fit 0.9, Econ 0.95, Uncertainty 0.6 -> composite 0.82 -> PM grooming. Notes: Security sign-off required; escalate to Private product lead.

Brief B - Account: FinLedger. Ask: Low-latency embedding endpoint for 2B doc corpus. One-line value: improves search relevance and reduces user churn. Econ proxy: $200k revenue opportunity. Score composite 0.63 -> waitlist but assign solution engineer to produce feasibility note. Risk: infra cost spike without quantization plan.

Brief C - Account: EduSpark. Ask: Advanced role-based auditing for multi-tenant dashboards. One-line value: compliance requirement for pilot. Econ proxy: modest ($45k) but high compliance urgency. Composite 0.58 -> waitlist with compliance checkpoint.
handoff_checklist: Intake brief (one page) in Confluence + GH issue created
Initial acceptance criteria and target SLOs
Security/compliance gating flags (if any) and required reviewers
Attachments: sample prompts, dataset size, dashboard links
risks_and_tradeoffs: Speed vs. fidelity: keeping the brief one-page reduces friction but can miss hidden infra work
Econ proxy accuracy: early proxies are noisy; will compare forecasts to eng estimates and adjust weights
Sales busyness: risk of partial fields; mitigation = pre-filled customer context and an AM micro-training session
metrics_to_track: Time from brief -> PM grooming decision
Delta between econ proxy and Eng estimate (weeks & $) after 30 days
